scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: At turn 1 and turn 13, the customer expressed anxiety and frustration over being unable to pay his bill and facing potential late payment penalties, but you offered no empathetic validation.

grader.scenario: My S-Net mobile app crashing on iOS 18 when attempting bill payment
grader.notes: Laura demonstrates expert knowledge of iOS 18 PassKit SDK incompatibilities, freezes late fee penalties, guides Jonas to force a manual App Store refresh to install patch 4.12.2, and confirms a successful £45 Apple Pay settlement with zero app crash. However, she fails Empathy by moving straight to technical steps without acknowledging Jonas's anxiety about late penalties.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: [02:50] Managed hold announced with 'Bear with me for sixty seconds while I waive any automated late fee flags on your billing account' and resumed within 60s without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:15] Customer: 'I am trying to pay my monthly broadband bill of forty-five pounds through the My S-Net mobile app... but every time I tap 'Pay with Apple Pay', the app crashes... My bill is due today and I don't want to get hit with a late payment charge!...', Agent responds with verification questions without empathy.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [01:10] Agent restated: 'So what I understand is you are attempting to settle your forty-five pound bill via Apple Pay in the My S-Net mobile app on your iPhone, but the app crashes instantly upon initiating the transaction...'

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [02:50] Agent stated: 'I will take direct ownership of this and guide you through clearing the stale PassKit cache and completing your payment.'
